literal: I ask for being given {} -- arjū with the verbal noun iʿṭāʾ and -ī (me), so nothing addresses the listener; aʿṭinī was the masculine imperative (aʿṭīnī to a woman) and min faḍlak the masculine suffix (faḍlik to a woman)
